title: 第 7 课 · 按键开关（push button）
summary: 四只脚的按键为什么要横跨中间的凹槽？
description: 先看「拆开看」里的 **按键与拨动开关**（左侧会自动打开）：四只脚里哪两只是一体的。
**这一课学什么**：四脚轻触按键的内部，以及为什么它要横跨凹槽。
**1. 四脚按键的内部**
常见的 6×6 mm 轻触按键有 4 只脚，但电气上只有 2 个端子：
| 脚 | 属于 | 关系 |
| 1a、1b | 端子 1 | 内部永远相通 |
| 2a、2b | 端子 2 | 内部永远相通 |
| 端子 1 ↔ 端子 2 | — | 按下时接通，松开时断开（常开，normally open） |
**2. 为什么要横跨凹槽**
按键放在 e5（锚点），四只脚落在：
| | 第 5 列 | 第 7 列 |
| e 行（凹槽上方） | 1a = e5 | 2a = e7 |
| f 行（凹槽下方） | 1b = f5 | 2b = f7 |
第 5 列是开关的一端、第 7 列是另一端，按下才接通。如果按键不跨凹槽、四只脚都插在 a–e 区，同一列上下两只脚本来就被金属条连着——要么开关永远是通的，要么完全没用。
**3. 本课电路**
+5V → 按键 → 220 Ω → LED → GND。按键放在凹槽上，所以电阻和 LED 接在下半区（f–j），GND 用下方蓝轨 bn。电源模块同时给上下两组轨道供电，所以下方轨道也有电。
tests 会分别检查：松开时 LED 灭，按下时 LED 亮。

en.title: Lesson 7 · Push buttons
en.summary: Why does a four-leg push button have to straddle the trench in the middle?
description: Look at the **Push button & slide switch** teardown first (it opens on the left): which of the four legs are joined inside.
**What you learn**: what is inside a four-leg tactile button, and why it straddles the trench.
**1. Inside a four-leg button**
The common 6×6 mm tactile button has 4 legs but only 2 electrical terminals:
| Legs | Terminal | Relation |
| 1a, 1b | terminal 1 | always joined inside |
| 2a, 2b | terminal 2 | always joined inside |
| terminal 1 ↔ terminal 2 | — | connected while pressed, open when released (normally open) |
**2. Why it straddles the trench**
With the button at e5 (its anchor) the four legs land in:
| | column 5 | column 7 |
| row e (above the trench) | 1a = e5 | 2a = e7 |
| row f (below the trench) | 1b = f5 | 2b = f7 |

Column 5 is one end of the switch and column 7 the other; they only connect while it is pressed. If the button sat entirely in rows a–e, the legs in the same column would already be joined by the strip — the switch would either be always on or do nothing at all.
**3. This lesson's circuit**

+5V → button → 220 Ω → LED → GND. The button sits on the trench, so the resistor and LED go in the lower half (f–j) and GND is the bottom blue rail bn. The power module feeds both pairs of rails, so the bottom rails are live too.
The tests check both states: released → LED off, pressed → LED on.
steps: Power module in column 1 (5V): all four rails, top and bottom, are powered.
Red jumper tp5 → a5: the top half of column 5 = +5V.
Place the push button at e5, straddling the trench: its four legs are in e5, e7, f5 and f7. Column 5 is the switch input and column 7 is the output.
The 220Ω resistor starts from the bottom half of column 7: h7 – h11.
LED long lead i11, short lead i14; blue jumper j14 → bn14 (bottom − rail).
Done! Click the button to try it: pressed → column 5 and column 7 connect → the LED lights.
hints: The button must straddle the trench in the middle (placed on row e); then the left and right columns are the two ends of the switch.
Inside the button, the top and bottom legs on the same side are always connected.

steps.text: 电源模块插在第 1 列（5V），上下四条轨道都通电。
红色跳线 tp5 → a5：第 5 列上半段 = +5V。
按键放在 e5，横跨凹槽：四只脚在 e5、e7、f5、f7。第 5 列是开关输入端，第 7 列是输出端。
220Ω 电阻从第 7 列下半段出发：h7 – h11。
LED 长脚 i11、短脚 i14；蓝色跳线 j14 → bn14（下方 − 轨）。
完成！点击按键试试：按下 → 第 5 列和第 7 列接通 → LED 亮。

hints: 按键要横跨中间凹槽（放在 e 行），左右两列才是开关的两端。
按键内部同一侧的上下两只脚永远相通。
